description: ACN-Data is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. ACN-Data exists to help researchers access real data around electric vehicle charging. The dataset is made possible by a close collaboration with PowerFlex Systems which operates Adaptive Charging Networks around the United States. Oak Ridge National Laboratory harvested 26 records of the dataset for data discovery purposes. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Electricity. Its keywords are electric vehicles, electric vehicle charging. The portal shows 2025-12-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
